title: Google Search Central: Information Gain and Helpful Content Guidelines
author: Google Search Relations
content:
Creating Helpful, Reliable, People-First Content

Google's automated ranking systems are designed to present helpful, reliable information that's primarily created to benefit people, rather than to gain search engine rankings.

"Does your content provide substantial value when compared to other pages in search results, offering unique insights or original reporting?"

Key Signals for Content Evaluation

Content created primarily for search engine traffic often exhibits high redundancy with existing top-ranking results, resulting in lower information gain scores.

FactorEvaluation CriteriaImpact Weight
Original DataFirst-party findings and proprietary statisticsHigh
